headline: Foxparks flamethrower
title: Foxparks | Your Early Flamethrower | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want fire early? Foxparks is an early Fire Pal found around level five to seven in Palworld one point zero. Its partner skill, Huggy Fire, equips it to you as a flamethrower when activated. At your base it works Kindling level one, so it can light your first furnaces. Will you use Foxparks as a weapon? Comment below!
description: Foxparks in Palworld 1.0: an early Fire Pal around level 5 to 7 that becomes a flamethrower with its Huggy Fire partner skill.
